loop.top3_why_not: Candidate B has a higher validation score and a larger gap to the leader; its weights are derived from a pooled meta‑model trained on other series, which may not capture the specific trend‑dominated nature of this series. Candidate C, while using inverse‑error weights, shows higher per‑window errors and a larger gap to the best score, indicating less stability. Both B and C are therefore less suitable than A for this series.
